name: Discovery Coverage Engine
description: Configuration for determining explored areas, underexplored areas, evidence gaps, and confidence gaps.

coverageStates.name: Explored Area
coverageStates.description: An area with participant-provided examples, sufficient context, and at least tentative understanding.

coverageStates.name: Underexplored Area
coverageStates.description: An area that may matter but has not been explored with enough participant context.

coverageStates.name: Evidence Gap
coverageStates.description: An area where a possible observation exists but support is thin, abstract, or unconfirmed.

coverageStates.name: Confidence Gap
coverageStates.description: An area where confidence is lower than the importance or participant significance of the theme.

evaluationGuidance: Coverage should guide curiosity, not pressure the participant.
Participant significance can outweigh schema breadth.
An area may remain underexplored by participant choice.
Coverage should preserve what is unknown and what remains open.
Do not use coverage as a completion checklist.
